name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reach.hardAt_of_take
title: Two input laws that agree on their first m bits are a decision problem with k bits whenever 2^k <= m + 1 (input-head locality)
statement: If the laws D and D' have the same image under List.take m, then every machine A satisfies 2^k * gain <= cost for the decision problem between D and D', whenever 2^k <= m + 1. A machine whose clock is at most m reads only the first m input bits, so its acceptance probabilities coincide (gain 0); a machine with a larger clock already costs more than m. In particular an encryption whose message-dependent bits start after position 2^128 is secure in this machine model without any assumption.
